input: # The newline is the record separator. A trailing one is conventional and
# CRLF counts as one newline (the engine's line matcher scans a run of line
# Blank lines between records are tolerated, for the same reason: a run of
# line characters arrives as ONE separator token.
# A document of only separators holds zero records.
# Spaces and tabs around a record are insignificant, as in JSON.
# A blank line containing whitespace is still just a separator. It lexes as
# #LN #SP #LN rather than one #LN, so the grammar has to skip the extra
# separator explicitly — these rows pin that it does.
